release) to avoid flinging. Outside demo mode, **never finish a match or
add notes** on the owner's account without asking, and blur real people's
names (`blur` boxes). Writing files into the repo while recording makes the
dev client flash a blue "Refreshing…" banner — cut around it.

- **Screenshots:** raw iPhone PNGs go in `screenshots-raw/` (gitignored),
  named per the `SHOTS` list in `scripts/process-screenshots.mjs`;
  `pnpm --filter @riftlog/web screenshots` crops the status bar, blurs
  `blur` boxes, and writes 1x/2x WebP plus the size manifest. Render them
  only through `PhoneFrame`. Landscape shots (`board-landscape`,
  `between-games-landscape`) are captured with Simulator cmd+← (`rotate:
  270`; a cmd+→ capture needs 90); `PhoneFrame` draws the island band on the
  right for any shot wider than tall. The hero shows the landscape board via
  `HeroPhone`'s rotate button.
- **Recordings** (`public/videos/<name>.mp4` + `.webm`, listed in
  `src/components/videos.ts`): record with
  `xcrun simctl io booted recordVideo --codec=h264 --force screenshots-raw/<name>.mp4`
  (stop it with `pkill -INT -f "simctl io booted recordVideo"`), find the cut
  points on a contact sheet (`ffmpeg -i x.mp4 -vf "fps=2,scale=160:-1,tile=10x4"
  -frames:v 1 sheet.png`), then cut, crop the status bar (162 px at 3x), scale
  to 2x (780 wide portrait, 1592 landscape after `transpose=2`), and encode
  H.264 (`-crf 26 -movflags +faststart`, no audio) and VP9 (`-crf 38`).
  Clips are silent, a few seconds, ~100–250 KB. `PhoneFrame video=…` →
  `LoopVideo`: plays only while on screen, never with reduced motion (the
  poster still stands in). The face-off (`intro`) has its own wide strip,
  `FaceOff`, under the hero. Feature rows size their phones by count
  (`PHONE_W` in `FeatureSection`) so a row fits the desktop width.

  named per the `SHOTS` list in `scripts/process-screenshots.mjs`;
  `pnpm --filter @riftlog/web screenshots` crops the status bar, blurs
  `blur` boxes, and writes 1x/2x WebP plus the size manifest. Render them
  only through `PhoneFrame`. Landscape shots (`board-landscape`,
  `between-games-landscape`) are captured with Simulator cmd+← (`rotate:
  270`; a cmd+→ capture needs 90); `PhoneFrame` draws the island band on the
  right for any shot wider than tall. The hero shows the landscape board via
  `HeroPhone`'s rotate button.
- **Recordings** (`public/videos/<name>.mp4` + `.webm`, listed in
  `src/components/videos.ts`): record with
  `xcrun simctl io booted recordVideo --codec=h264 --force screenshots-raw/<name>.mp4`
  (stop it with `pkill -INT -f "simctl io booted recordVideo"`), find the cut
  points on a contact sheet (`ffmpeg -i x.mp4 -vf "fps=2,scale=160:-1,tile=10x4"
  -frames:v 1 sheet.png`), then cut, crop the status bar (162 px at 3x), scale
  to 2x (780 wide portrait, 1592 landscape after `transpose=2`), and encode
  H.264 (`-crf 26 -movflags +faststart`, no audio) and VP9 (`-crf 38`).
  Clips are silent, a few seconds, ~100–250 KB. `PhoneFrame video=…` →
  `LoopVideo`: plays only while on screen, never with reduced motion (the
  poster still stands in). The face-off (`intro`) has its own wide strip,
  `FaceOff`, under the hero. Feature rows size their phones by count
  (`PHONE_W` in `FeatureSection`) so a row fits the desktop width.
n**Taking the shots** in the app's **demo mode** (`apps/mobile/lib/demo.ts`:
start Metro with `EXPO_PUBLIC_DEMO=1` — a varied, made-up history with
fictional opponents around the owner's real Rivon deck; nothing is saved,
so a demo match may be played to the end). Card art is allowed in shots
and clips. Set a clean status bar with
`xcrun simctl status_bar booted override --time 9:41 --batteryState charged --batteryLevel 100 --cellularBars 4 --wifiBars 3`,
capture with `xcrun simctl io booted screenshot screenshots-raw/<name>.png`,
and `xcrun simctl status_bar booted clear` afterwards. Mouse-wheel scrolling
doesn't work in the simulator; drag slowly (mouse down, small moves, pause,
release) to avoid flinging. Outside demo mode, **never finish a match or
add notes** on the owner's account without asking, and blur real people's
names (`blur` boxes). Writing files into the repo while recording makes the
dev client flash a blue "Refreshing…" banner — cut around it.

  `between-games-landscape`) are captured with Simulator cmd+← (`rotate:
  270`; a cmd+→ capture needs 90); `PhoneFrame` draws the island band on the
  right for any shot wider than tall. The hero shows the landscape board via
  `HeroPhone`'s rotate button.
- **Recordings** (`public/videos/<name>.mp4` + `.webm`, listed in
  `src/components/videos.ts`): record with
  `xcrun simctl io booted recordVideo --codec=h264 --force screenshots-raw/<name>.mp4`
  (stop it with `pkill -INT -f "simctl io booted recordVideo"`), find the cut
  points on a contact sheet (`ffmpeg -i x.mp4 -vf "fps=2,scale=160:-1,tile=10x4"
  -frames:v 1 sheet.png`), then cut, crop the status bar (162 px at 3x), scale
  to 2x (780 wide portrait, 1592 landscape after `transpose=2`), and encode
  H.264 (`-crf 26 -movflags +faststart`, no audio) and VP9 (`-crf 38`).
  Clips are silent, a few seconds, ~100–250 KB. `PhoneFrame video=…` →
  `LoopVideo`: plays only while on screen, never with reduced motion (the
  poster still stands in). The face-off (`intro`) has its own wide strip,
  `FaceOff`, under the hero. Feature rows size their phones by count
  (`PHONE_W` in `FeatureSection`) so a row fits the desktop width.

- **Recordings** (`public/videos/<name>.mp4` + `.webm`, listed in
  `src/components/videos.ts`): record with
  `xcrun simctl io booted recordVideo --codec=h264 --force screenshots-raw/<name>.mp4`
  (stop it with `pkill -INT -f "simctl io booted recordVideo"`), find the cut
  points on a contact sheet (`ffmpeg -i x.mp4 -vf "fps=2,scale=160:-1,tile=10x4"
  -frames:v 1 sheet.png`), then cut, crop the status bar (162 px at 3x), scale
  to 2x (780 wide portrait, 1592 landscape after `transpose=2`), and encode
  H.264 (`-crf 26 -movflags +faststart`, no audio) and VP9 (`-crf 38`).
  Clips are silent, a few seconds, ~100–250 KB. `PhoneFrame video=…` →
  `LoopVideo`: plays only while on screen, never with reduced motion (the
  poster still stands in). The face-off (`intro`) has its own wide strip,
  `FaceOff`, under the hero. Feature rows size their phones by count
  (`PHONE_W` in `FeatureSection`) so a row fits the desktop width.
 **Taking the shots** in the app's **demo mode** (`apps/mobile/lib/demo.ts`:
start Metro with `EXPO_PUBLIC_DEMO=1` — a varied, made-up history with
fictional opponents around the owner's real Rivon deck; nothing is saved,
so a demo match may be played to the end). Card art is allowed in shots
and clips. Set a clean status bar with
`xcrun simctl status_bar booted override --time 9:41 --batteryState charged --batteryLevel 100 --cellularBars 4 --wifiBars 3`,
capture with `xcrun simctl io booted screenshot screenshots-raw/<name>.png`,
and `xcrun simctl status_bar booted clear` afterwards. Mouse-wheel scrolling
doesn't work in the simulator; drag slowly (mouse down, small moves, pause,
release) to avoid flinging. Outside demo mode, **never finish a match or
add notes** on the owner's account without asking, and blur real people's
names (`blur` boxes). Writing files into the repo while recording makes the
dev client flash a blue "Refreshing…" banner — cut around it.

  points on a contact sheet (`ffmpeg -i x.mp4 -vf "fps=2,scale=160:-1,tile=10x4"
  -frames:v 1 sheet.png`), then cut, crop the status bar (162 px at 3x), scale
  to 2x (780 wide portrait, 1592 landscape after `transpose=2`), and encode
  H.264 (`-crf 26 -movflags +faststart`, no audio) and VP9 (`-crf 38`).
  Clips are silent, a few seconds, ~100–250 KB. `PhoneFrame video=…` →
  `LoopVideo`: plays only while on screen, never with reduced motion (the
  poster still stands in). The face-off (`intro`) has its own wide strip,
  `FaceOff`, under the hero. Feature rows size their phones by count
  (`PHONE_W` in `FeatureSection`) so a row fits the desktop width.
d**Taking the shots** in the app's **demo mode** (`apps/mobile/lib/demo.ts`:
start Metro with `EXPO_PUBLIC_DEMO=1` — a varied, made-up history with
fictional opponents around the owner's real Rivon deck; nothing is saved,
so a demo match may be played to the end). Card art is allowed in shots
and clips. Set a clean status bar with
`xcrun simctl status_bar booted override --time 9:41 --batteryState charged --batteryLevel 100 --cellularBars 4 --wifiBars 3`,
capture with `xcrun simctl io booted screenshot screenshots-raw/<name>.png`,
and `xcrun simctl status_bar booted clear` afterwards. Mouse-wheel scrolling
doesn't work in the simulator; drag slowly (mouse down, small moves, pause,
release) to avoid flinging. Outside demo mode, **never finish a match or
add notes** on the owner's account without asking, and blur real people's
names (`blur` boxes). Writing files into the repo while recording makes the
dev client flash a blue "Refreshing…" banner — cut around it.

  only through `PhoneFrame`. Landscape shots (`board-landscape`,
  `between-games-landscape`) are captured with Simulator cmd+← (`rotate:
  270`; a cmd+→ capture needs 90); `PhoneFrame` draws the island band on the
  right for any shot wider than tall. The hero shows the landscape board via
  `HeroPhone`'s rotate button.

  to 2x (780 wide portrait, 1592 landscape after `transpose=2`), and encode
  H.264 (`-crf 26 -movflags +faststart`, no audio) and VP9 (`-crf 38`).
  Clips are silent, a few seconds, ~100–250 KB. `PhoneFrame video=…` →
  `LoopVideo`: plays only while on screen, never with reduced motion (the
  poster still stands in). The face-off (`intro`) has its own wide strip,
  `FaceOff`, under the hero. Feature rows size their phones by count
  (`PHONE_W` in `FeatureSection`) so a row fits the desktop width.
 **Taking the shots** in the app's **demo mode** (`apps/mobile/lib/demo.ts`:
start Metro with `EXPO_PUBLIC_DEMO=1` — a varied, made-up history with
fictional opponents around the owner's real Rivon deck; nothing is saved,
so a demo match may be played to the end). Card art is allowed in shots
and clips. Set a clean status bar with
`xcrun simctl status_bar booted override --time 9:41 --batteryState charged --batteryLevel 100 --cellularBars 4 --wifiBars 3`,
capture with `xcrun simctl io booted screenshot screenshots-raw/<name>.png`,
and `xcrun simctl status_bar booted clear` afterwards. Mouse-wheel scrolling
doesn't work in the simulator; drag slowly (mouse down, small moves, pause,
release) to avoid flinging. Outside demo mode, **never finish a match or
add notes** on the owner's account without asking, and blur real people's
names (`blur` boxes). Writing files into the repo while recording makes the
dev client flash a blue "Refreshing…" banner — cut around it.

  named per the `SHOTS` list in `scripts/process-screenshots.mjs`;
  `pnpm --filter @riftlog/web screenshots` crops the status bar, blurs
  `blur` boxes, and writes 1x/2x WebP plus the size manifest. Render them
  only through `PhoneFrame`. Landscape shots (`board-landscape`,
  `between-games-landscape`) are captured with Simulator cmd+← (`rotate:
  270`; a cmd+→ capture needs 90); `PhoneFrame` draws the island band on the
  right for any shot wider than tall. The hero shows the landscape board via
  `HeroPhone`'s rotate button.

  Clips are silent, a few seconds, ~100–250 KB. `PhoneFrame video=…` →
  `LoopVideo`: plays only while on screen, never with reduced motion (the
  poster still stands in). The face-off (`intro`) has its own wide strip,
  `FaceOff`, under the hero. Feature rows size their phones by count
  (`PHONE_W` in `FeatureSection`) so a row fits the desktop width.
a**Taking the shots** in the app's **demo mode** (`apps/mobile/lib/demo.ts`:
start Metro with `EXPO_PUBLIC_DEMO=1` — a varied, made-up history with
fictional opponents around the owner's real Rivon deck; nothing is saved,
so a demo match may be played to the end). Card art is allowed in shots
and clips. Set a clean status bar with
`xcrun simctl status_bar booted override --time 9:41 --batteryState charged --batteryLevel 100 --cellularBars 4 --wifiBars 3`,
capture with `xcrun simctl io booted screenshot screenshots-raw/<name>.png`,
and `xcrun simctl status_bar booted clear` afterwards. Mouse-wheel scrolling
doesn't work in the simulator; drag slowly (mouse down, small moves, pause,
release) to avoid flinging. Outside demo mode, **never finish a match or
add notes** on the owner's account without asking, and blur real people's
names (`blur` boxes). Writing files into the repo while recording makes the
dev client flash a blue "Refreshing…" banner — cut around it.

- **Screenshots:** raw iPhone PNGs go in `screenshots-raw/` (gitignored),
  named per the `SHOTS` list in `scripts/process-screenshots.mjs`;
  `pnpm --filter @riftlog/web screenshots` crops the status bar, blurs
  `blur` boxes, and writes 1x/2x WebP plus the size manifest. Render them
  only through `PhoneFrame`. Landscape shots (`board-landscape`,
  `between-games-landscape`) are captured with Simulator cmd+← (`rotate:
  270`; a cmd+→ capture needs 90); `PhoneFrame` draws the island band on the
  right for any shot wider than tall. The hero shows the landscape board via
  `HeroPhone`'s rotate button.
- **Recordings** (`public/videos/<name>.mp4` + `.webm`, listed in
  `src/components/videos.ts`): record with
  `xcrun simctl io booted recordVideo --codec=h264 --force screenshots-raw/<name>.mp4`
  (stop it with `pkill -INT -f "simctl io booted recordVideo"`), find the cut
  points on a contact sheet (`ffmpeg -i x.mp4 -vf "fps=2,scale=160:-1,tile=10x4"
  -frames:v 1 sheet.png`), then cut, crop the status bar (162 px at 3x), scale
  to 2x (780 wide portrait, 1592 landscape after `transpose=2`), and encode
  H.264 (`-crf 26 -movflags +faststart`, no audio) and VP9 (`-crf 38`).
  Clips are silent, a few seconds, ~100–250 KB. `PhoneFrame video=…` →
  `LoopVideo`: plays only while on screen, never with reduced motion (the
  poster still stands in). The face-off (`intro`) has its own wide strip,
  `FaceOff`, under the hero. Feature rows size their phones by count
  (`PHONE_W` in `FeatureSection`) so a row fits the desktop width.

  (`PHONE_W` in `FeatureSection`) so a row fits the desktop width.
s**Taking the shots** in the app's **demo mode** (`apps/mobile/lib/demo.ts`:
start Metro with `EXPO_PUBLIC_DEMO=1` — a varied, made-up history with
fictional opponents around the owner's real Rivon deck; nothing is saved,
so a demo match may be played to the end). Card art is allowed in shots
and clips. Set a clean status bar with
`xcrun simctl status_bar booted override --time 9:41 --batteryState charged --batteryLevel 100 --cellularBars 4 --wifiBars 3`,
capture with `xcrun simctl io booted screenshot screenshots-raw/<name>.png`,
and `xcrun simctl status_bar booted clear` afterwards. Mouse-wheel scrolling
doesn't work in the simulator; drag slowly (mouse down, small moves, pause,
release) to avoid flinging. Outside demo mode, **never finish a match or
add notes** on the owner's account without asking, and blur real people's
names (`blur` boxes). Writing files into the repo while recording makes the
dev client flash a blue "Refreshing…" banner — cut around it.

- **Screenshots:** raw iPhone PNGs go in `screenshots-raw/` (gitignored),
  named per the `SHOTS` list in `scripts/process-screenshots.mjs`;
  `pnpm --filter @riftlog/web screenshots` crops the status bar, blurs
  `blur` boxes, and writes 1x/2x WebP plus the size manifest. Render them
  only through `PhoneFrame`. Landscape shots (`board-landscape`,
  `between-games-landscape`) are captured with Simulator cmd+← (`rotate:
  270`; a cmd+→ capture needs 90); `PhoneFrame` draws the island band on the
  right for any shot wider than tall. The hero shows the landscape board via
  `HeroPhone`'s rotate button.
- **Recordings** (`public/videos/<name>.mp4` + `.webm`, listed in
  `src/components/videos.ts`): record with
  `xcrun simctl io booted recordVideo --codec=h264 --force screenshots-raw/<name>.mp4`
  (stop it with `pkill -INT -f "simctl io booted recordVideo"`), find the cut
  points on a contact sheet (`ffmpeg -i x.mp4 -vf "fps=2,scale=160:-1,tile=10x4"
  -frames:v 1 sheet.png`), then cut, crop the status bar (162 px at 3x), scale
  to 2x (780 wide portrait, 1592 landscape after `transpose=2`), and encode
  H.264 (`-crf 26 -movflags +faststart`, no audio) and VP9 (`-crf 38`).
  Clips are silent, a few seconds, ~100–250 KB. `PhoneFrame video=…` →
  `LoopVideo`: plays only while on screen, never with reduced motion (the
  poster still stands in). The face-off (`intro`) has its own wide strip,
  `FaceOff`, under the hero. Feature rows size their phones by count
  (`PHONE_W` in `FeatureSection`) so a row fits the desktop width.

so a demo match may be played to the end). Card art is allowed in shots
and clips. Set a clean status bar with
`xcrun simctl status_bar booted override --time 9:41 --batteryState charged --batteryLevel 100 --cellularBars 4 --wifiBars 3`,
capture with `xcrun simctl io booted screenshot screenshots-raw/<name>.png`,
and `xcrun simctl status_bar booted clear` afterwards. Mouse-wheel scrolling
doesn't work in the simulator; drag slowly (mouse down, small moves, pause,
release) to avoid flinging. Outside demo mode, **never finish a match or
add notes** on the owner's account without asking, and blur real people's
names (`blur` boxes). Writing files into the repo while recording makes the
dev client flash a blue "Refreshing…" banner — cut around it.

- **Screenshots:** raw iPhone PNGs go in `screenshots-raw/` (gitignored),
  named per the `SHOTS` list in `scripts/process-screenshots.mjs`;
  `pnpm --filter @riftlog/web screenshots` crops the status bar, blurs
  `blur` boxes, and writes 1x/2x WebP plus the size manifest. Render them
  only through `PhoneFrame`. Landscape shots (`board-landscape`,
  `between-games-landscape`) are captured with Simulator cmd+← (`rotate:
  270`; a cmd+→ capture needs 90); `PhoneFrame` draws the island band on the
  right for any shot wider than tall. The hero shows the landscape board via
  `HeroPhone`'s rotate button.
- **Recordings** (`public/videos/<name>.mp4` + `.webm`, listed in
  `src/components/videos.ts`): record with
  `xcrun simctl io booted recordVideo --codec=h264 --force screenshots-raw/<name>.mp4`
  (stop it with `pkill -INT -f "simctl io booted recordVideo"`), find the cut
  points on a contact sheet (`ffmpeg -i x.mp4 -vf "fps=2,scale=160:-1,tile=10x4"
  -frames:v 1 sheet.png`), then cut, crop the status bar (162 px at 3x), scale
  to 2x (780 wide portrait, 1592 landscape after `transpose=2`), and encode
  H.264 (`-crf 26 -movflags +faststart`, no audio) and VP9 (`-crf 38`).
  Clips are silent, a few seconds, ~100–250 KB. `PhoneFrame video=…` →
  `LoopVideo`: plays only while on screen, never with reduced motion (the
  poster still stands in). The face-off (`intro`) has its own wide strip,
  `FaceOff`, under the hero. Feature rows size their phones by count
  (`PHONE_W` in `FeatureSection`) so a row fits the desktop width.

and `xcrun simctl status_bar booted clear` afterwards. Mouse-wheel scrolling
doesn't work in the simulator; drag slowly (mouse down, small moves, pause,
release) to avoid flinging. Outside demo mode, **never finish a match or
add notes** on the owner's account without asking, and blur real people's
names (`blur` boxes). Writing files into the repo while recording makes the
dev client flash a blue "Refreshing…" banner — cut around it.

- **Screenshots:** raw iPhone PNGs go in `screenshots-raw/` (gitignored),
  named per the `SHOTS` list in `scripts/process-screenshots.mjs`;
  `pnpm --filter @riftlog/web screenshots` crops the status bar, blurs
  `blur` boxes, and writes 1x/2x WebP plus the size manifest. Render them
  only through `PhoneFrame`. Landscape shots (`board-landscape`,
  `between-games-landscape`) are captured with Simulator cmd+← (`rotate:
  270`; a cmd+→ capture needs 90); `PhoneFrame` draws the island band on the
  right for any shot wider than tall. The hero shows the landscape board via
  `HeroPhone`'s rotate button.
- **Recordings** (`public/videos/<name>.mp4` + `.webm`, listed in
  `src/components/videos.ts`): record with
  `xcrun simctl io booted recordVideo --codec=h264 --force screenshots-raw/<name>.mp4`
  (stop it with `pkill -INT -f "simctl io booted recordVideo"`), find the cut
  points on a contact sheet (`ffmpeg -i x.mp4 -vf "fps=2,scale=160:-1,tile=10x4"
  -frames:v 1 sheet.png`), then cut, crop the status bar (162 px at 3x), scale
  to 2x (780 wide portrait, 1592 landscape after `transpose=2`), and encode
  H.264 (`-crf 26 -movflags +faststart`, no audio) and VP9 (`-crf 38`).
  Clips are silent, a few seconds, ~100–250 KB. `PhoneFrame video=…` →
  `LoopVideo`: plays only while on screen, never with reduced motion (the
  poster still stands in). The face-off (`intro`) has its own wide strip,
  `FaceOff`, under the hero. Feature rows size their phones by count
  (`PHONE_W` in `FeatureSection`) so a row fits the desktop width.

names (`blur` boxes). Writing files into the repo while recording makes the
dev client flash a blue "Refreshing…" banner — cut around it.

- **Screenshots:** raw iPhone PNGs go in `screenshots-raw/` (gitignored),
  named per the `SHOTS` list in `scripts/process-screenshots.mjs`;
  `pnpm --filter @riftlog/web screenshots` crops the status bar, blurs
  `blur` boxes, and writes 1x/2x WebP plus the size manifest. Render them
  only through `PhoneFrame`. Landscape shots (`board-landscape`,
  `between-games-landscape`) are captured with Simulator cmd+← (`rotate:
  270`; a cmd+→ capture needs 90); `PhoneFrame` draws the island band on the
  right for any shot wider than tall. The hero shows the landscape board via
  `HeroPhone`'s rotate button.
- **Recordings** (`public/videos/<name>.mp4` + `.webm`, listed in
  `src/components/videos.ts`): record with
  `xcrun simctl io booted recordVideo --codec=h264 --force screenshots-raw/<name>.mp4`
  (stop it with `pkill -INT -f "simctl io booted recordVideo"`), find the cut
  points on a contact sheet (`ffmpeg -i x.mp4 -vf "fps=2,scale=160:-1,tile=10x4"
  -frames:v 1 sheet.png`), then cut, crop the status bar (162 px at 3x), scale
  to 2x (780 wide portrait, 1592 landscape after `transpose=2`), and encode
  H.264 (`-crf 26 -movflags +faststart`, no audio) and VP9 (`-crf 38`).
  Clips are silent, a few seconds, ~100–250 KB. `PhoneFrame video=…` →
  `LoopVideo`: plays only while on screen, never with reduced motion (the
  poster still stands in). The face-off (`intro`) has its own wide strip,
  `FaceOff`, under the hero. Feature rows size their phones by count
  (`PHONE_W` in `FeatureSection`) so a row fits the desktop width.

  `pnpm --filter @riftlog/web screenshots` crops the status bar, blurs
  `blur` boxes, and writes 1x/2x WebP plus the size manifest. Render them
  only through `PhoneFrame`. Landscape shots (`board-landscape`,
  `between-games-landscape`) are captured with Simulator cmd+← (`rotate:
  270`; a cmd+→ capture needs 90); `PhoneFrame` draws the island band on the
  right for any shot wider than tall. The hero shows the landscape board via
  `HeroPhone`'s rotate button.
- **Recordings** (`public/videos/<name>.mp4` + `.webm`, listed in
  `src/components/videos.ts`): record with
  `xcrun simctl io booted recordVideo --codec=h264 --force screenshots-raw/<name>.mp4`
  (stop it with `pkill -INT -f "simctl io booted recordVideo"`), find the cut
  points on a contact sheet (`ffmpeg -i x.mp4 -vf "fps=2,scale=160:-1,tile=10x4"
  -frames:v 1 sheet.png`), then cut, crop the status bar (162 px at 3x), scale
  to 2x (780 wide portrait, 1592 landscape after `transpose=2`), and encode
  H.264 (`-crf 26 -movflags +faststart`, no audio) and VP9 (`-crf 38`).
  Clips are silent, a few seconds, ~100–250 KB. `PhoneFrame video=…` →
  `LoopVideo`: plays only while on screen, never with reduced motion (the
  poster still stands in). The face-off (`intro`) has its own wide strip,
  `FaceOff`, under the hero. Feature rows size their phones by count
  (`PHONE_W` in `FeatureSection`) so a row fits the desktop width.
 **Taking the shots** in the app's **demo mode** (`apps/mobile/lib/demo.ts`:
start Metro with `EXPO_PUBLIC_DEMO=1` — a varied, made-up history with
fictional opponents around the owner's real Rivon deck; nothing is saved,
so a demo match may be played to the end). Card art is allowed in shots
and clips. Set a clean status bar with
`xcrun simctl status_bar booted override --time 9:41 --batteryState charged --batteryLevel 100 --cellularBars 4 --wifiBars 3`,
capture with `xcrun simctl io booted screenshot screenshots-raw/<name>.png`,
and `xcrun simctl status_bar booted clear` afterwards. Mouse-wheel scrolling
doesn't work in the simulator; drag slowly (mouse down, small moves, pause,
release) to avoid flinging. Outside demo mode, **never finish a match or
add notes** on the owner's account without asking, and blur real people's
names (`blur` boxes). Writing files into the repo while recording makes the
dev client flash a blue "Refreshing…" banner — cut around it.

  270`; a cmd+→ capture needs 90); `PhoneFrame` draws the island band on the
  right for any shot wider than tall. The hero shows the landscape board via
  `HeroPhone`'s rotate button.
- **Recordings** (`public/videos/<name>.mp4` + `.webm`, listed in
  `src/components/videos.ts`): record with
  `xcrun simctl io booted recordVideo --codec=h264 --force screenshots-raw/<name>.mp4`
  (stop it with `pkill -INT -f "simctl io booted recordVideo"`), find the cut
  points on a contact sheet (`ffmpeg -i x.mp4 -vf "fps=2,scale=160:-1,tile=10x4"
  -frames:v 1 sheet.png`), then cut, crop the status bar (162 px at 3x), scale
  to 2x (780 wide portrait, 1592 landscape after `transpose=2`), and encode
  H.264 (`-crf 26 -movflags +faststart`, no audio) and VP9 (`-crf 38`).
  Clips are silent, a few seconds, ~100–250 KB. `PhoneFrame video=…` →
  `LoopVideo`: plays only while on screen, never with reduced motion (the
  poster still stands in). The face-off (`intro`) has its own wide strip,
  `FaceOff`, under the hero. Feature rows size their phones by count
  (`PHONE_W` in `FeatureSection`) so a row fits the desktop width.

  `xcrun simctl io booted recordVideo --codec=h264 --force screenshots-raw/<name>.mp4`
  (stop it with `pkill -INT -f "simctl io booted recordVideo"`), find the cut
  points on a contact sheet (`ffmpeg -i x.mp4 -vf "fps=2,scale=160:-1,tile=10x4"
  -frames:v 1 sheet.png`), then cut, crop the status bar (162 px at 3x), scale
  to 2x (780 wide portrait, 1592 landscape after `transpose=2`), and encode
  H.264 (`-crf 26 -movflags +faststart`, no audio) and VP9 (`-crf 38`).
  Clips are silent, a few seconds, ~100–250 KB. `PhoneFrame video=…` →
  `LoopVideo`: plays only while on screen, never with reduced motion (the
  poster still stands in). The face-off (`intro`) has its own wide strip,
  `FaceOff`, under the hero. Feature rows size their phones by count
  (`PHONE_W` in `FeatureSection`) so a row fits the desktop width.
c**Taking the shots** in the app's **demo mode** (`apps/mobile/lib/demo.ts`:
start Metro with `EXPO_PUBLIC_DEMO=1` — a varied, made-up history with
fictional opponents around the owner's real Rivon deck; nothing is saved,
so a demo match may be played to the end). Card art is allowed in shots
and clips. Set a clean status bar with
`xcrun simctl status_bar booted override --time 9:41 --batteryState charged --batteryLevel 100 --cellularBars 4 --wifiBars 3`,
capture with `xcrun simctl io booted screenshot screenshots-raw/<name>.png`,
and `xcrun simctl status_bar booted clear` afterwards. Mouse-wheel scrolling
doesn't work in the simulator; drag slowly (mouse down, small moves, pause,
release) to avoid flinging. Outside demo mode, **never finish a match or
add notes** on the owner's account without asking, and blur real people's
names (`blur` boxes). Writing files into the repo while recording makes the
dev client flash a blue "Refreshing…" banner — cut around it.

- **Screenshots:** raw iPhone PNGs go in `screenshots-raw/` (gitignored),
  named per the `SHOTS` list in `scripts/process-screenshots.mjs`;
  `pnpm --filter @riftlog/web screenshots` crops the status bar, blurs
  `blur` boxes, and writes 1x/2x WebP plus the size manifest. Render them
  only through `PhoneFrame`. Landscape shots (`board-landscape`,
  `between-games-landscape`) are captured with Simulator cmd+← (`rotate:
  270`; a cmd+→ capture needs 90); `PhoneFrame` draws the island band on the
  right for any shot wider than tall. The hero shows the landscape board via
  `HeroPhone`'s rotate button.

  H.264 (`-crf 26 -movflags +faststart`, no audio) and VP9 (`-crf 38`).
  Clips are silent, a few seconds, ~100–250 KB. `PhoneFrame video=…` →
  `LoopVideo`: plays only while on screen, never with reduced motion (the
  poster still stands in). The face-off (`intro`) has its own wide strip,
  `FaceOff`, under the hero. Feature rows size their phones by count
  (`PHONE_W` in `FeatureSection`) so a row fits the desktop width.
o**Taking the shots** in the app's **demo mode** (`apps/mobile/lib/demo.ts`:
start Metro with `EXPO_PUBLIC_DEMO=1` — a varied, made-up history with
fictional opponents around the owner's real Rivon deck; nothing is saved,
so a demo match may be played to the end). Card art is allowed in shots
and clips. Set a clean status bar with
`xcrun simctl status_bar booted override --time 9:41 --batteryState charged --batteryLevel 100 --cellularBars 4 --wifiBars 3`,
capture with `xcrun simctl io booted screenshot screenshots-raw/<name>.png`,
and `xcrun simctl status_bar booted clear` afterwards. Mouse-wheel scrolling
doesn't work in the simulator; drag slowly (mouse down, small moves, pause,
release) to avoid flinging. Outside demo mode, **never finish a match or
add notes** on the owner's account without asking, and blur real people's
names (`blur` boxes). Writing files into the repo while recording makes the
dev client flash a blue "Refreshing…" banner — cut around it.

- **Screenshots:** raw iPhone PNGs go in `screenshots-raw/` (gitignored),
  named per the `SHOTS` list in `scripts/process-screenshots.mjs`;
  `pnpm --filter @riftlog/web screenshots` crops the status bar, blurs
  `blur` boxes, and writes 1x/2x WebP plus the size manifest. Render them
  only through `PhoneFrame`. Landscape shots (`board-landscape`,
  `between-games-landscape`) are captured with Simulator cmd+← (`rotate:
  270`; a cmd+→ capture needs 90); `PhoneFrame` draws the island band on the
  right for any shot wider than tall. The hero shows the landscape board via
  `HeroPhone`'s rotate button.
- **Recordings** (`public/videos/<name>.mp4` + `.webm`, listed in
  `src/components/videos.ts`): record with
  `xcrun simctl io booted recordVideo --codec=h264 --force screenshots-raw/<name>.mp4`
  (stop it with `pkill -INT -f "simctl io booted recordVideo"`), find the cut
  points on a contact sheet (`ffmpeg -i x.mp4 -vf "fps=2,scale=160:-1,tile=10x4"
  -frames:v 1 sheet.png`), then cut, crop the status bar (162 px at 3x), scale
  to 2x (780 wide portrait, 1592 landscape after `transpose=2`), and encode
  H.264 (`-crf 26 -movflags +faststart`, no audio) and VP9 (`-crf 38`).
  Clips are silent, a few seconds, ~100–250 KB. `PhoneFrame video=…` →
  `LoopVideo`: plays only while on screen, never with reduced motion (the
  poster still stands in). The face-off (`intro`) has its own wide strip,
  `FaceOff`, under the hero. Feature rows size their phones by count
  (`PHONE_W` in `FeatureSection`) so a row fits the desktop width.

  (`PHONE_W` in `FeatureSection`) so a row fits the desktop width.
h**Taking the shots** in the app's **demo mode** (`apps/mobile/lib/demo.ts`:
start Metro with `EXPO_PUBLIC_DEMO=1` — a varied, made-up history with
fictional opponents around the owner's real Rivon deck; nothing is saved,
so a demo match may be played to the end). Card art is allowed in shots
and clips. Set a clean status bar with
`xcrun simctl status_bar booted override --time 9:41 --batteryState charged --batteryLevel 100 --cellularBars 4 --wifiBars 3`,
capture with `xcrun simctl io booted screenshot screenshots-raw/<name>.png`,
and `xcrun simctl status_bar booted clear` afterwards. Mouse-wheel scrolling
doesn't work in the simulator; drag slowly (mouse down, small moves, pause,
release) to avoid flinging. Outside demo mode, **never finish a match or
add notes** on the owner's account without asking, and blur real people's
names (`blur` boxes). Writing files into the repo while recording makes the
dev client flash a blue "Refreshing…" banner — cut around it.

- **Screenshots:** raw iPhone PNGs go in `screenshots-raw/` (gitignored),
  named per the `SHOTS` list in `scripts/process-screenshots.mjs`;
  `pnpm --filter @riftlog/web screenshots` crops the status bar, blurs
  `blur` boxes, and writes 1x/2x WebP plus the size manifest. Render them
  only through `PhoneFrame`. Landscape shots (`board-landscape`,
  `between-games-landscape`) are captured with Simulator cmd+← (`rotate:
  270`; a cmd+→ capture needs 90); `PhoneFrame` draws the island band on the
  right for any shot wider than tall. The hero shows the landscape board via
  `HeroPhone`'s rotate button.
- **Recordings** (`public/videos/<name>.mp4` + `.webm`, listed in
  `src/components/videos.ts`): record with
  `xcrun simctl io booted recordVideo --codec=h264 --force screenshots-raw/<name>.mp4`
  (stop it with `pkill -INT -f "simctl io booted recordVideo"`), find the cut
  points on a contact sheet (`ffmpeg -i x.mp4 -vf "fps=2,scale=160:-1,tile=10x4"
  -frames:v 1 sheet.png`), then cut, crop the status bar (162 px at 3x), scale
  to 2x (780 wide portrait, 1592 landscape after `transpose=2`), and encode
  H.264 (`-crf 26 -movflags +faststart`, no audio) and VP9 (`-crf 38`).
  Clips are silent, a few seconds, ~100–250 KB. `PhoneFrame video=…` →
  `LoopVideo`: plays only while on screen, never with reduced motion (the
  poster still stands in). The face-off (`intro`) has its own wide strip,
  `FaceOff`, under the hero. Feature rows size their phones by count
  (`PHONE_W` in `FeatureSection`) so a row fits the desktop width.

start Metro with `EXPO_PUBLIC_DEMO=1` — a varied, made-up history with
fictional opponents around the owner's real Rivon deck; nothing is saved,
so a demo match may be played to the end). Card art is allowed in shots
and clips. Set a clean status bar with
`xcrun simctl status_bar booted override --time 9:41 --batteryState charged --batteryLevel 100 --cellularBars 4 --wifiBars 3`,
capture with `xcrun simctl io booted screenshot screenshots-raw/<name>.png`,
and `xcrun simctl status_bar booted clear` afterwards. Mouse-wheel scrolling
doesn't work in the simulator; drag slowly (mouse down, small moves, pause,
release) to avoid flinging. Outside demo mode, **never finish a match or
add notes** on the owner's account without asking, and blur real people's
names (`blur` boxes). Writing files into the repo while recording makes the
dev client flash a blue "Refreshing…" banner — cut around it.

- **Screenshots:** raw iPhone PNGs go in `screenshots-raw/` (gitignored),
  named per the `SHOTS` list in `scripts/process-screenshots.mjs`;
  `pnpm --filter @riftlog/web screenshots` crops the status bar, blurs
  `blur` boxes, and writes 1x/2x WebP plus the size manifest. Render them
  only through `PhoneFrame`. Landscape shots (`board-landscape`,
  `between-games-landscape`) are captured with Simulator cmd+← (`rotate:
  270`; a cmd+→ capture needs 90); `PhoneFrame` draws the island band on the
  right for any shot wider than tall. The hero shows the landscape board via
  `HeroPhone`'s rotate button.
- **Recordings** (`public/videos/<name>.mp4` + `.webm`, listed in
  `src/components/videos.ts`): record with
  `xcrun simctl io booted recordVideo --codec=h264 --force screenshots-raw/<name>.mp4`
  (stop it with `pkill -INT -f "simctl io booted recordVideo"`), find the cut
  points on a contact sheet (`ffmpeg -i x.mp4 -vf "fps=2,scale=160:-1,tile=10x4"
  -frames:v 1 sheet.png`), then cut, crop the status bar (162 px at 3x), scale
  to 2x (780 wide portrait, 1592 landscape after `transpose=2`), and encode
  H.264 (`-crf 26 -movflags +faststart`, no audio) and VP9 (`-crf 38`).
  Clips are silent, a few seconds, ~100–250 KB. `PhoneFrame video=…` →
  `LoopVideo`: plays only while on screen, never with reduced motion (the
  poster still stands in). The face-off (`intro`) has its own wide strip,
  `FaceOff`, under the hero. Feature rows size their phones by count
  (`PHONE_W` in `FeatureSection`) so a row fits the desktop width.

`xcrun simctl status_bar booted override --time 9:41 --batteryState charged --batteryLevel 100 --cellularBars 4 --wifiBars 3`,
capture with `xcrun simctl io booted screenshot screenshots-raw/<name>.png`,
and `xcrun simctl status_bar booted clear` afterwards. Mouse-wheel scrolling
doesn't work in the simulator; drag slowly (mouse down, small moves, pause,
release) to avoid flinging. Outside demo mode, **never finish a match or
add notes** on the owner's account without asking, and blur real people's
names (`blur` boxes). Writing files into the repo while recording makes the
dev client flash a blue "Refreshing…" banner — cut around it.

- **Screenshots:** raw iPhone PNGs go in `screenshots-raw/` (gitignored),
  named per the `SHOTS` list in `scripts/process-screenshots.mjs`;
  `pnpm --filter @riftlog/web screenshots` crops the status bar, blurs
  `blur` boxes, and writes 1x/2x WebP plus the size manifest. Render them
  only through `PhoneFrame`. Landscape shots (`board-landscape`,
  `between-games-landscape`) are captured with Simulator cmd+← (`rotate:
  270`; a cmd+→ capture needs 90); `PhoneFrame` draws the island band on the
  right for any shot wider than tall. The hero shows the landscape board via
  `HeroPhone`'s rotate button.
- **Recordings** (`public/videos/<name>.mp4` + `.webm`, listed in
  `src/components/videos.ts`): record with
  `xcrun simctl io booted recordVideo --codec=h264 --force screenshots-raw/<name>.mp4`
  (stop it with `pkill -INT -f "simctl io booted recordVideo"`), find the cut
  points on a contact sheet (`ffmpeg -i x.mp4 -vf "fps=2,scale=160:-1,tile=10x4"
  -frames:v 1 sheet.png`), then cut, crop the status bar (162 px at 3x), scale
  to 2x (780 wide portrait, 1592 landscape after `transpose=2`), and encode
  H.264 (`-crf 26 -movflags +faststart`, no audio) and VP9 (`-crf 38`).
  Clips are silent, a few seconds, ~100–250 KB. `PhoneFrame video=…` →
  `LoopVideo`: plays only while on screen, never with reduced motion (the
  poster still stands in). The face-off (`intro`) has its own wide strip,
  `FaceOff`, under the hero. Feature rows size their phones by count
  (`PHONE_W` in `FeatureSection`) so a row fits the desktop width.

release) to avoid flinging. Outside demo mode, **never finish a match or
add notes** on the owner's account without asking, and blur real people's
names (`blur` boxes). Writing files into the repo while recording makes the
dev client flash a blue "Refreshing…" banner — cut around it.

- **Screenshots:** raw iPhone PNGs go in `screenshots-raw/` (gitignored),
  named per the `SHOTS` list in `scripts/process-screenshots.mjs`;
  `pnpm --filter @riftlog/web screenshots` crops the status bar, blurs
  `blur` boxes, and writes 1x/2x WebP plus the size manifest. Render them
  only through `PhoneFrame`. Landscape shots (`board-landscape`,
  `between-games-landscape`) are captured with Simulator cmd+← (`rotate:
  270`; a cmd+→ capture needs 90); `PhoneFrame` draws the island band on the
  right for any shot wider than tall. The hero shows the landscape board via
  `HeroPhone`'s rotate button.
- **Recordings** (`public/videos/<name>.mp4` + `.webm`, listed in
  `src/components/videos.ts`): record with
  `xcrun simctl io booted recordVideo --codec=h264 --force screenshots-raw/<name>.mp4`
  (stop it with `pkill -INT -f "simctl io booted recordVideo"`), find the cut
  points on a contact sheet (`ffmpeg -i x.mp4 -vf "fps=2,scale=160:-1,tile=10x4"
  -frames:v 1 sheet.png`), then cut, crop the status bar (162 px at 3x), scale
  to 2x (780 wide portrait, 1592 landscape after `transpose=2`), and encode
  H.264 (`-crf 26 -movflags +faststart`, no audio) and VP9 (`-crf 38`).
  Clips are silent, a few seconds, ~100–250 KB. `PhoneFrame video=…` →
  `LoopVideo`: plays only while on screen, never with reduced motion (the
  poster still stands in). The face-off (`intro`) has its own wide strip,
  `FaceOff`, under the hero. Feature rows size their phones by count
  (`PHONE_W` in `FeatureSection`) so a row fits the desktop width.

  named per the `SHOTS` list in `scripts/process-screenshots.mjs`;
  `pnpm --filter @riftlog/web screenshots` crops the status bar, blurs
  `blur` boxes, and writes 1x/2x WebP plus the size manifest. Render them
  only through `PhoneFrame`. Landscape shots (`board-landscape`,
  `between-games-landscape`) are captured with Simulator cmd+← (`rotate:
  270`; a cmd+→ capture needs 90); `PhoneFrame` draws the island band on the
  right for any shot wider than tall. The hero shows the landscape board via
  `HeroPhone`'s rotate button.
- **Recordings** (`public/videos/<name>.mp4` + `.webm`, listed in
  `src/components/videos.ts`): record with
  `xcrun simctl io booted recordVideo --codec=h264 --force screenshots-raw/<name>.mp4`
  (stop it with `pkill -INT -f "simctl io booted recordVideo"`), find the cut
  points on a contact sheet (`ffmpeg -i x.mp4 -vf "fps=2,scale=160:-1,tile=10x4"
  -frames:v 1 sheet.png`), then cut, crop the status bar (162 px at 3x), scale
  to 2x (780 wide portrait, 1592 landscape after `transpose=2`), and encode
  H.264 (`-crf 26 -movflags +faststart`, no audio) and VP9 (`-crf 38`).
  Clips are silent, a few seconds, ~100–250 KB. `PhoneFrame video=…` →
  `LoopVideo`: plays only while on screen, never with reduced motion (the
  poster still stands in). The face-off (`intro`) has its own wide strip,
  `FaceOff`, under the hero. Feature rows size their phones by count
  (`PHONE_W` in `FeatureSection`) so a row fits the desktop width.
 **Taking the shots** in the app's **demo mode** (`apps/mobile/lib/demo.ts`:
start Metro with `EXPO_PUBLIC_DEMO=1` — a varied, made-up history with
fictional opponents around the owner's real Rivon deck; nothing is saved,
so a demo match may be played to the end). Card art is allowed in shots
and clips. Set a clean status bar with
`xcrun simctl status_bar booted override --time 9:41 --batteryState charged --batteryLevel 100 --cellularBars 4 --wifiBars 3`,
capture with `xcrun simctl io booted screenshot screenshots-raw/<name>.png`,
and `xcrun simctl status_bar booted clear` afterwards. Mouse-wheel scrolling
doesn't work in the simulator; drag slowly (mouse down, small moves, pause,
release) to avoid flinging. Outside demo mode, **never finish a match or
add notes** on the owner's account without asking, and blur real people's
names (`blur` boxes). Writing files into the repo while recording makes the
dev client flash a blue "Refreshing…" banner — cut around it.

  `between-games-landscape`) are captured with Simulator cmd+← (`rotate:
  270`; a cmd+→ capture needs 90); `PhoneFrame` draws the island band on the
  right for any shot wider than tall. The hero shows the landscape board via
  `HeroPhone`'s rotate button.
- **Recordings** (`public/videos/<name>.mp4` + `.webm`, listed in
  `src/components/videos.ts`): record with
  `xcrun simctl io booted recordVideo --codec=h264 --force screenshots-raw/<name>.mp4`
  (stop it with `pkill -INT -f "simctl io booted recordVideo"`), find the cut
  points on a contact sheet (`ffmpeg -i x.mp4 -vf "fps=2,scale=160:-1,tile=10x4"
  -frames:v 1 sheet.png`), then cut, crop the status bar (162 px at 3x), scale
  to 2x (780 wide portrait, 1592 landscape after `transpose=2`), and encode
  H.264 (`-crf 26 -movflags +faststart`, no audio) and VP9 (`-crf 38`).
  Clips are silent, a few seconds, ~100–250 KB. `PhoneFrame video=…` →
  `LoopVideo`: plays only while on screen, never with reduced motion (the
  poster still stands in). The face-off (`intro`) has its own wide strip,
  `FaceOff`, under the hero. Feature rows size their phones by count
  (`PHONE_W` in `FeatureSection`) so a row fits the desktop width.

- **Recordings** (`public/videos/<name>.mp4` + `.webm`, listed in
  `src/components/videos.ts`): record with
  `xcrun simctl io booted recordVideo --codec=h264 --force screenshots-raw/<name>.mp4`
  (stop it with `pkill -INT -f "simctl io booted recordVideo"`), find the cut
  points on a contact sheet (`ffmpeg -i x.mp4 -vf "fps=2,scale=160:-1,tile=10x4"
  -frames:v 1 sheet.png`), then cut, crop the status bar (162 px at 3x), scale
  to 2x (780 wide portrait, 1592 landscape after `transpose=2`), and encode
  H.264 (`-crf 26 -movflags +faststart`, no audio) and VP9 (`-crf 38`).
  Clips are silent, a few seconds, ~100–250 KB. `PhoneFrame video=…` →
  `LoopVideo`: plays only while on screen, never with reduced motion (the
  poster still stands in). The face-off (`intro`) has its own wide strip,
  `FaceOff`, under the hero. Feature rows size their phones by count
  (`PHONE_W` in `FeatureSection`) so a row fits the desktop width.
o**Taking the shots** in the app's **demo mode** (`apps/mobile/lib/demo.ts`:
start Metro with `EXPO_PUBLIC_DEMO=1` — a varied, made-up history with
fictional opponents around the owner's real Rivon deck; nothing is saved,
so a demo match may be played to the end). Card art is allowed in shots
and clips. Set a clean status bar with
`xcrun simctl status_bar booted override --time 9:41 --batteryState charged --batteryLevel 100 --cellularBars 4 --wifiBars 3`,
capture with `xcrun simctl io booted screenshot screenshots-raw/<name>.png`,
and `xcrun simctl status_bar booted clear` afterwards. Mouse-wheel scrolling
doesn't work in the simulator; drag slowly (mouse down, small moves, pause,
release) to avoid flinging. Outside demo mode, **never finish a match or
add notes** on the owner's account without asking, and blur real people's
names (`blur` boxes). Writing files into the repo while recording makes the
dev client flash a blue "Refreshing…" banner — cut around it.

  points on a contact sheet (`ffmpeg -i x.mp4 -vf "fps=2,scale=160:-1,tile=10x4"
  -frames:v 1 sheet.png`), then cut, crop the status bar (162 px at 3x), scale
  to 2x (780 wide portrait, 1592 landscape after `transpose=2`), and encode
  H.264 (`-crf 26 -movflags +faststart`, no audio) and VP9 (`-crf 38`).
  Clips are silent, a few seconds, ~100–250 KB. `PhoneFrame video=…` →
  `LoopVideo`: plays only while on screen, never with reduced motion (the
  poster still stands in). The face-off (`intro`) has its own wide strip,
  `FaceOff`, under the hero. Feature rows size their phones by count
  (`PHONE_W` in `FeatureSection`) so a row fits the desktop width.
D**Taking the shots** in the app's **demo mode** (`apps/mobile/lib/demo.ts`:
start Metro with `EXPO_PUBLIC_DEMO=1` — a varied, made-up history with
fictional opponents around the owner's real Rivon deck; nothing is saved,
so a demo match may be played to the end). Card art is allowed in shots

and `xcrun simctl status_bar booted clear` afterwards. Mouse-wheel scrolling
doesn't work in the simulator; drag slowly (mouse down, small moves, pause,
release) to avoid flinging. Outside demo mode, **never finish a match or
add notes** on the owner's account without asking, and blur real people's
names (`blur` boxes). Writing files into the repo while recording makes the
dev client flash a blue "Refreshing…" banner — cut around it.

  to 2x (780 wide portrait, 1592 landscape after `transpose=2`), and encode
  H.264 (`-crf 26 -movflags +faststart`, no audio) and VP9 (`-crf 38`).
  Clips are silent, a few seconds, ~100–250 KB. `PhoneFrame video=…` →
  `LoopVideo`: plays only while on screen, never with reduced motion (the
  poster still stands in). The face-off (`intro`) has its own wide strip,
  `FaceOff`, under the hero. Feature rows size their phones by count
  (`PHONE_W` in `FeatureSection`) so a row fits the desktop width.
t**Taking the shots** in the app's **demo mode** (`apps/mobile/lib/demo.ts`:
start Metro with `EXPO_PUBLIC_DEMO=1` — a varied, made-up history with
fictional opponents around the owner's real Rivon deck; nothing is saved,
so a demo match may be played to the end). Card art is allowed in shots
and clips. Set a clean status bar with
`xcrun simctl status_bar booted override --time 9:41 --batteryState charged --batteryLevel 100 --cellularBars 4 --wifiBars 3`,
capture with `xcrun simctl io booted screenshot screenshots-raw/<name>.png`,
and `xcrun simctl status_bar booted clear` afterwards. Mouse-wheel scrolling
doesn't work in the simulator; drag slowly (mouse down, small moves, pause,
release) to avoid flinging. Outside demo mode, **never finish a match or
add notes** on the owner's account without asking, and blur real people's
names (`blur` boxes). Writing files into the repo while recording makes the
dev client flash a blue "Refreshing…" banner — cut around it.

  only through `PhoneFrame`. Landscape shots (`board-landscape`,
  `between-games-landscape`) are captured with Simulator cmd+← (`rotate:
  270`; a cmd+→ capture needs 90); `PhoneFrame` draws the island band on the
  right for any shot wider than tall. The hero shows the landscape board via
  `HeroPhone`'s rotate button.

  Clips are silent, a few seconds, ~100–250 KB. `PhoneFrame video=…` →
  `LoopVideo`: plays only while on screen, never with reduced motion (the
  poster still stands in). The face-off (`intro`) has its own wide strip,
  `FaceOff`, under the hero. Feature rows size their phones by count
  (`PHONE_W` in `FeatureSection`) so a row fits the desktop width.
`**Taking the shots** in the app's **demo mode** (`apps/mobile/lib/demo.ts`:
start Metro with `EXPO_PUBLIC_DEMO=1` — a varied, made-up history with
fictional opponents around the owner's real Rivon deck; nothing is saved,
so a demo match may be played to the end). Card art is allowed in shots
and clips. Set a clean status bar with
`xcrun simctl status_bar booted override --time 9:41 --batteryState charged --batteryLevel 100 --cellularBars 4 --wifiBars 3`,
capture with `xcrun simctl io booted screenshot screenshots-raw/<name>.png`,
and `xcrun simctl status_bar booted clear` afterwards. Mouse-wheel scrolling
doesn't work in the simulator; drag slowly (mouse down, small moves, pause,
release) to avoid flinging. Outside demo mode, **never finish a match or
add notes** on the owner's account without asking, and blur real people's
names (`blur` boxes). Writing files into the repo while recording makes the
dev client flash a blue "Refreshing…" banner — cut around it.

- **Screenshots:** raw iPhone PNGs go in `screenshots-raw/` (gitignored),
  named per the `SHOTS` list in `scripts/process-screenshots.mjs`;
  `pnpm --filter @riftlog/web screenshots` crops the status bar, blurs
  `blur` boxes, and writes 1x/2x WebP plus the size manifest. Render them
  only through `PhoneFrame`. Landscape shots (`board-landscape`,
  `between-games-landscape`) are captured with Simulator cmd+← (`rotate:
  270`; a cmd+→ capture needs 90); `PhoneFrame` draws the island band on the
  right for any shot wider than tall. The hero shows the landscape board via
  `HeroPhone`'s rotate button.
- **Recordings** (`public/videos/<name>.mp4` + `.webm`, listed in
  `src/components/videos.ts`): record with
  `xcrun simctl io booted recordVideo --codec=h264 --force screenshots-raw/<name>.mp4`
  (stop it with `pkill -INT -f "simctl io booted recordVideo"`), find the cut
  points on a contact sheet (`ffmpeg -i x.mp4 -vf "fps=2,scale=160:-1,tile=10x4"
  -frames:v 1 sheet.png`), then cut, crop the status bar (162 px at 3x), scale
  to 2x (780 wide portrait, 1592 landscape after `transpose=2`), and encode
  H.264 (`-crf 26 -movflags +faststart`, no audio) and VP9 (`-crf 38`).
  Clips are silent, a few seconds, ~100–250 KB. `PhoneFrame video=…` →
  `LoopVideo`: plays only while on screen, never with reduced motion (the
  poster still stands in). The face-off (`intro`) has its own wide strip,
  `FaceOff`, under the hero. Feature rows size their phones by count
  (`PHONE_W` in `FeatureSection`) so a row fits the desktop width.

  (`PHONE_W` in `FeatureSection`) so a row fits the desktop width.
r**Taking the shots** in the app's **demo mode** (`apps/mobile/lib/demo.ts`:
start Metro with `EXPO_PUBLIC_DEMO=1` — a varied, made-up history with
fictional opponents around the owner's real Rivon deck; nothing is saved,
so a demo match may be played to the end). Card art is allowed in shots
and clips. Set a clean status bar with
`xcrun simctl status_bar booted override --time 9:41 --batteryState charged --batteryLevel 100 --cellularBars 4 --wifiBars 3`,
capture with `xcrun simctl io booted screenshot screenshots-raw/<name>.png`,
and `xcrun simctl status_bar booted clear` afterwards. Mouse-wheel scrolling
doesn't work in the simulator; drag slowly (mouse down, small moves, pause,
release) to avoid flinging. Outside demo mode, **never finish a match or
add notes** on the owner's account without asking, and blur real people's
names (`blur` boxes). Writing files into the repo while recording makes the
dev client flash a blue "Refreshing…" banner — cut around it.

- **Screenshots:** raw iPhone PNGs go in `screenshots-raw/` (gitignored),
  named per the `SHOTS` list in `scripts/process-screenshots.mjs`;
  `pnpm --filter @riftlog/web screenshots` crops the status bar, blurs
  `blur` boxes, and writes 1x/2x WebP plus the size manifest. Render them
  only through `PhoneFrame`. Landscape shots (`board-landscape`,
  `between-games-landscape`) are captured with Simulator cmd+← (`rotate:
  270`; a cmd+→ capture needs 90); `PhoneFrame` draws the island band on the
  right for any shot wider than tall. The hero shows the landscape board via
  `HeroPhone`'s rotate button.
- **Recordings** (`public/videos/<name>.mp4` + `.webm`, listed in
  `src/components/videos.ts`): record with
  `xcrun simctl io booted recordVideo --codec=h264 --force screenshots-raw/<name>.mp4`
  (stop it with `pkill -INT -f "simctl io booted recordVideo"`), find the cut
  points on a contact sheet (`ffmpeg -i x.mp4 -vf "fps=2,scale=160:-1,tile=10x4"
  -frames:v 1 sheet.png`), then cut, crop the status bar (162 px at 3x), scale
  to 2x (780 wide portrait, 1592 landscape after `transpose=2`), and encode
  H.264 (`-crf 26 -movflags +faststart`, no audio) and VP9 (`-crf 38`).
  Clips are silent, a few seconds, ~100–250 KB. `PhoneFrame video=…` →
  `LoopVideo`: plays only while on screen, never with reduced motion (the
  poster still stands in). The face-off (`intro`) has its own wide strip,
  `FaceOff`, under the hero. Feature rows size their phones by count
  (`PHONE_W` in `FeatureSection`) so a row fits the desktop width.

so a demo match may be played to the end). Card art is allowed in shots
and clips. Set a clean status bar with
`xcrun simctl status_bar booted override --time 9:41 --batteryState charged --batteryLevel 100 --cellularBars 4 --wifiBars 3`,
capture with `xcrun simctl io booted screenshot screenshots-raw/<name>.png`,
and `xcrun simctl status_bar booted clear` afterwards. Mouse-wheel scrolling
doesn't work in the simulator; drag slowly (mouse down, small moves, pause,
release) to avoid flinging. Outside demo mode, **never finish a match or
add notes** on the owner's account without asking, and blur real people's
names (`blur` boxes). Writing files into the repo while recording makes the
dev client flash a blue "Refreshing…" banner — cut around it.

- **Screenshots:** raw iPhone PNGs go in `screenshots-raw/` (gitignored),
  named per the `SHOTS` list in `scripts/process-screenshots.mjs`;
  `pnpm --filter @riftlog/web screenshots` crops the status bar, blurs
  `blur` boxes, and writes 1x/2x WebP plus the size manifest. Render them
  only through `PhoneFrame`. Landscape shots (`board-landscape`,
  `between-games-landscape`) are captured with Simulator cmd+← (`rotate:
  270`; a cmd+→ capture needs 90); `PhoneFrame` draws the island band on the
  right for any shot wider than tall. The hero shows the landscape board via
  `HeroPhone`'s rotate button.
- **Recordings** (`public/videos/<name>.mp4` + `.webm`, listed in
  `src/components/videos.ts`): record with
  `xcrun simctl io booted recordVideo --codec=h264 --force screenshots-raw/<name>.mp4`
  (stop it with `pkill -INT -f "simctl io booted recordVideo"`), find the cut
  points on a contact sheet (`ffmpeg -i x.mp4 -vf "fps=2,scale=160:-1,tile=10x4"
  -frames:v 1 sheet.png`), then cut, crop the status bar (162 px at 3x), scale
  to 2x (780 wide portrait, 1592 landscape after `transpose=2`), and encode
  H.264 (`-crf 26 -movflags +faststart`, no audio) and VP9 (`-crf 38`).
  Clips are silent, a few seconds, ~100–250 KB. `PhoneFrame video=…` →
  `LoopVideo`: plays only while on screen, never with reduced motion (the
  poster still stands in). The face-off (`intro`) has its own wide strip,
  `FaceOff`, under the hero. Feature rows size their phones by count
  (`PHONE_W` in `FeatureSection`) so a row fits the desktop width.

and `xcrun simctl status_bar booted clear` afterwards. Mouse-wheel scrolling
doesn't work in the simulator; drag slowly (mouse down, small moves, pause,
release) to avoid flinging. Outside demo mode, **never finish a match or
add notes** on the owner's account without asking, and blur real people's
names (`blur` boxes). Writing files into the repo while recording makes the
dev client flash a blue "Refreshing…" banner — cut around it.

- **Screenshots:** raw iPhone PNGs go in `screenshots-raw/` (gitignored),
  named per the `SHOTS` list in `scripts/process-screenshots.mjs`;
  `pnpm --filter @riftlog/web screenshots` crops the status bar, blurs
  `blur` boxes, and writes 1x/2x WebP plus the size manifest. Render them
  only through `PhoneFrame`. Landscape shots (`board-landscape`,
  `between-games-landscape`) are captured with Simulator cmd+← (`rotate:
  270`; a cmd+→ capture needs 90); `PhoneFrame` draws the island band on the
  right for any shot wider than tall. The hero shows the landscape board via
  `HeroPhone`'s rotate button.
- **Recordings** (`public/videos/<name>.mp4` + `.webm`, listed in
  `src/components/videos.ts`): record with
  `xcrun simctl io booted recordVideo --codec=h264 --force screenshots-raw/<name>.mp4`
  (stop it with `pkill -INT -f "simctl io booted recordVideo"`), find the cut
  points on a contact sheet (`ffmpeg -i x.mp4 -vf "fps=2,scale=160:-1,tile=10x4"
  -frames:v 1 sheet.png`), then cut, crop the status bar (162 px at 3x), scale
  to 2x (780 wide portrait, 1592 landscape after `transpose=2`), and encode
  H.264 (`-crf 26 -movflags +faststart`, no audio) and VP9 (`-crf 38`).
  Clips are silent, a few seconds, ~100–250 KB. `PhoneFrame video=…` →
  `LoopVideo`: plays only while on screen, never with reduced motion (the
  poster still stands in). The face-off (`intro`) has its own wide strip,
  `FaceOff`, under the hero. Feature rows size their phones by count
  (`PHONE_W` in `FeatureSection`) so a row fits the desktop width.

names (`blur` boxes). Writing files into the repo while recording makes the
dev client flash a blue "Refreshing…" banner — cut around it.

- **Screenshots:** raw iPhone PNGs go in `screenshots-raw/` (gitignored),
  named per the `SHOTS` list in `scripts/process-screenshots.mjs`;
  `pnpm --filter @riftlog/web screenshots` crops the status bar, blurs
  `blur` boxes, and writes 1x/2x WebP plus the size manifest. Render them
  only through `PhoneFrame`. Landscape shots (`board-landscape`,
  `between-games-landscape`) are captured with Simulator cmd+← (`rotate:
  270`; a cmd+→ capture needs 90); `PhoneFrame` draws the island band on the
  right for any shot wider than tall. The hero shows the landscape board via
  `HeroPhone`'s rotate button.
- **Recordings** (`public/videos/<name>.mp4` + `.webm`, listed in
  `src/components/videos.ts`): record with
  `xcrun simctl io booted recordVideo --codec=h264 --force screenshots-raw/<name>.mp4`
  (stop it with `pkill -INT -f "simctl io booted recordVideo"`), find the cut
  points on a contact sheet (`ffmpeg -i x.mp4 -vf "fps=2,scale=160:-1,tile=10x4"
  -frames:v 1 sheet.png`), then cut, crop the status bar (162 px at 3x), scale
  to 2x (780 wide portrait, 1592 landscape after `transpose=2`), and encode
  H.264 (`-crf 26 -movflags +faststart`, no audio) and VP9 (`-crf 38`).
  Clips are silent, a few seconds, ~100–250 KB. `PhoneFrame video=…` →
  `LoopVideo`: plays only while on screen, never with reduced motion (the
  poster still stands in). The face-off (`intro`) has its own wide strip,
  `FaceOff`, under the hero. Feature rows size their phones by count
  (`PHONE_W` in `FeatureSection`) so a row fits the desktop width.

  `pnpm --filter @riftlog/web screenshots` crops the status bar, blurs
  `blur` boxes, and writes 1x/2x WebP plus the size manifest. Render them
  only through `PhoneFrame`. Landscape shots (`board-landscape`,
  `between-games-landscape`) are captured with Simulator cmd+← (`rotate:
  270`; a cmd+→ capture needs 90); `PhoneFrame` draws the island band on the
  right for any shot wider than tall. The hero shows the landscape board via
  `HeroPhone`'s rotate button.
- **Recordings** (`public/videos/<name>.mp4` + `.webm`, listed in
  `src/components/videos.ts`): record with
  `xcrun simctl io booted recordVideo --codec=h264 --force screenshots-raw/<name>.mp4`
  (stop it with `pkill -INT -f "simctl io booted recordVideo"`), find the cut
  points on a contact sheet (`ffmpeg -i x.mp4 -vf "fps=2,scale=160:-1,tile=10x4"
  -frames:v 1 sheet.png`), then cut, crop the status bar (162 px at 3x), scale
  to 2x (780 wide portrait, 1592 landscape after `transpose=2`), and encode
  H.264 (`-crf 26 -movflags +faststart`, no audio) and VP9 (`-crf 38`).
  Clips are silent, a few seconds, ~100–250 KB. `PhoneFrame video=…` →
  `LoopVideo`: plays only while on screen, never with reduced motion (the
  poster still stands in). The face-off (`intro`) has its own wide strip,
  `FaceOff`, under the hero. Feature rows size their phones by count
  (`PHONE_W` in `FeatureSection`) so a row fits the desktop width.
k**Taking the shots** in the app's **demo mode** (`apps/mobile/lib/demo.ts`:
start Metro with `EXPO_PUBLIC_DEMO=1` — a varied, made-up history with
fictional opponents around the owner's real Rivon deck; nothing is saved,
so a demo match may be played to the end). Card art is allowed in shots
and clips. Set a clean status bar with
`xcrun simctl status_bar booted override --time 9:41 --batteryState charged --batteryLevel 100 --cellularBars 4 --wifiBars 3`,
capture with `xcrun simctl io booted screenshot screenshots-raw/<name>.png`,
and `xcrun simctl status_bar booted clear` afterwards. Mouse-wheel scrolling
doesn't work in the simulator; drag slowly (mouse down, small moves, pause,
release) to avoid flinging. Outside demo mode, **never finish a match or
add notes** on the owner's account without asking, and blur real people's
names (`blur` boxes). Writing files into the repo while recording makes the
dev client flash a blue "Refreshing…" banner — cut around it.

  270`; a cmd+→ capture needs 90); `PhoneFrame` draws the island band on the
  right for any shot wider than tall. The hero shows the landscape board via
  `HeroPhone`'s rotate button.
- **Recordings** (`public/videos/<name>.mp4` + `.webm`, listed in
  `src/components/videos.ts`): record with
  `xcrun simctl io booted recordVideo --codec=h264 --force screenshots-raw/<name>.mp4`
  (stop it with `pkill -INT -f "simctl io booted recordVideo"`), find the cut
  points on a contact sheet (`ffmpeg -i x.mp4 -vf "fps=2,scale=160:-1,tile=10x4"
  -frames:v 1 sheet.png`), then cut, crop the status bar (162 px at 3x), scale
  to 2x (780 wide portrait, 1592 landscape after `transpose=2`), and encode
  H.264 (`-crf 26 -movflags +faststart`, no audio) and VP9 (`-crf 38`).
  Clips are silent, a few seconds, ~100–250 KB. `PhoneFrame video=…` →
  `LoopVideo`: plays only while on screen, never with reduced motion (the
  poster still stands in). The face-off (`intro`) has its own wide strip,
  `FaceOff`, under the hero. Feature rows size their phones by count
  (`PHONE_W` in `FeatureSection`) so a row fits the desktop width.

  `xcrun simctl io booted recordVideo --codec=h264 --force screenshots-raw/<name>.mp4`
  (stop it with `pkill -INT -f "simctl io booted recordVideo"`), find the cut
  points on a contact sheet (`ffmpeg -i x.mp4 -vf "fps=2,scale=160:-1,tile=10x4"
  -frames:v 1 sheet.png`), then cut, crop the status bar (162 px at 3x), scale
  to 2x (780 wide portrait, 1592 landscape after `transpose=2`), and encode
  H.264 (`-crf 26 -movflags +faststart`, no audio) and VP9 (`-crf 38`).
  Clips are silent, a few seconds, ~100–250 KB. `PhoneFrame video=…` →
  `LoopVideo`: plays only while on screen, never with reduced motion (the
  poster still stands in). The face-off (`intro`) has its own wide strip,
  `FaceOff`, under the hero. Feature rows size their phones by count
  (`PHONE_W` in `FeatureSection`) so a row fits the desktop width.
n**Taking the shots** in the app's **demo mode** (`apps/mobile/lib/demo.ts`:
start Metro with `EXPO_PUBLIC_DEMO=1` — a varied, made-up history with
fictional opponents around the owner's real Rivon deck; nothing is saved,
so a demo match may be played to the end). Card art is allowed in shots
and clips. Set a clean status bar with
`xcrun simctl status_bar booted override --time 9:41 --batteryState charged --batteryLevel 100 --cellularBars 4 --wifiBars 3`,
capture with `xcrun simctl io booted screenshot screenshots-raw/<name>.png`,
and `xcrun simctl status_bar booted clear` afterwards. Mouse-wheel scrolling
doesn't work in the simulator; drag slowly (mouse down, small moves, pause,
release) to avoid flinging. Outside demo mode, **never finish a match or
add notes** on the owner's account without asking, and blur real people's
names (`blur` boxes). Writing files into the repo while recording makes the
dev client flash a blue "Refreshing…" banner — cut around it.

- **Screenshots:** raw iPhone PNGs go in `screenshots-raw/` (gitignored),
  named per the `SHOTS` list in `scripts/process-screenshots.mjs`;
  `pnpm --filter @riftlog/web screenshots` crops the status bar, blurs
  `blur` boxes, and writes 1x/2x WebP plus the size manifest. Render them
  only through `PhoneFrame`. Landscape shots (`board-landscape`,
  `between-games-landscape`) are captured with Simulator cmd+← (`rotate:
  270`; a cmd+→ capture needs 90); `PhoneFrame` draws the island band on the
  right for any shot wider than tall. The hero shows the landscape board via
  `HeroPhone`'s rotate button.

  -frames:v 1 sheet.png`), then cut, crop the status bar (162 px at 3x), scale
  to 2x (780 wide portrait, 1592 landscape after `transpose=2`), and encode
  H.264 (`-crf 26 -movflags +faststart`, no audio) and VP9 (`-crf 38`).
  Clips are silent, a few seconds, ~100–250 KB. `PhoneFrame video=…` →
  `LoopVideo`: plays only while on screen, never with reduced motion (the
  poster still stands in). The face-off (`intro`) has its own wide strip,
  `FaceOff`, under the hero. Feature rows size their phones by count
  (`PHONE_W` in `FeatureSection`) so a row fits the desktop width.

**Taking the shots** in the app's **demo mode** (`apps/mobile/lib/demo.ts`:
start Metro with `EXPO_PUBLIC_DEMO=1` — a varied, made-up history with
fictional opponents around the owner's real Rivon deck; nothing is saved,
so a demo match may be played to the end). Card art is allowed in shots
and clips. Set a clean status bar with
`xcrun simctl status_bar booted override --time 9:41 --batteryState charged --batteryLevel 100 --cellularBars 4 --wifiBars 3`,
capture with `xcrun simctl io booted screenshot screenshots-raw/<name>.png`,
and `xcrun simctl status_bar booted clear` afterwards. Mouse-wheel scrolling
doesn't work in the simulator; drag slowly (mouse down, small moves, pause,
release) to avoid flinging. Outside demo mode, **never finish a match or
add notes** on the owner's account without asking, and blur real people's
names (`blur` boxes). Writing files into the repo while recording makes the
dev client flash a blue "Refreshing…" banner — cut around it.

- **Screenshots:** raw iPhone PNGs go in `screenshots-raw/` (gitignored),
  named per the `SHOTS` list in `scripts/process-screenshots.mjs`;
  `pnpm --filter @riftlog/web screenshots` crops the status bar, blurs
  `blur` boxes, and writes 1x/2x WebP plus the size manifest. Render them
  only through `PhoneFrame`. Landscape shots (`board-landscape`,
  `between-games-landscape`) are captured with Simulator cmd+← (`rotate:
  270`; a cmd+→ capture needs 90); `PhoneFrame` draws the island band on the
  right for any shot wider than tall. The hero shows the landscape board via
  `HeroPhone`'s rotate button.

  `src/components/videos.ts`): record with
  `xcrun simctl io booted recordVideo --codec=h264 --force screenshots-raw/<name>.mp4`
  (stop it with `pkill -INT -f "simctl io booted recordVideo"`), find the cut
  points on a contact sheet (`ffmpeg -i x.mp4 -vf "fps=2,scale=160:-1,tile=10x4"
  -frames:v 1 sheet.png`), then cut, crop the status bar (162 px at 3x), scale
  to 2x (780 wide portrait, 1592 landscape after `transpose=2`), and encode
  H.264 (`-crf 26 -movflags +faststart`, no audio) and VP9 (`-crf 38`).

  `LoopVideo`: plays only while on screen, never with reduced motion (the
  poster still stands in). The face-off (`intro`) has its own wide strip,
  `FaceOff`, under the hero. Feature rows size their phones by count
  (`PHONE_W` in `FeatureSection`) so a row fits the desktop width.

  H.264 (`-crf 26 -movflags +faststart`, no audio) and VP9 (`-crf 38`).
  Clips are silent, a few seconds, ~100–250 KB. `PhoneFrame video=…` →
  `LoopVideo`: plays only while on screen, never with reduced motion (the
  poster still stands in). The face-off (`intro`) has its own wide strip,
  `FaceOff`, under the hero. Feature rows size their phones by count
  (`PHONE_W` in `FeatureSection`) so a row fits the desktop width.
s**Taking the shots** in the app's **demo mode** (`apps/mobile/lib/demo.ts`:
start Metro with `EXPO_PUBLIC_DEMO=1` — a varied, made-up history with
fictional opponents around the owner's real Rivon deck; nothing is saved,
so a demo match may be played to the end). Card art is allowed in shots
and clips. Set a clean status bar with
`xcrun simctl status_bar booted override --time 9:41 --batteryState charged --batteryLevel 100 --cellularBars 4 --wifiBars 3`,
capture with `xcrun simctl io booted screenshot screenshots-raw/<name>.png`,
and `xcrun simctl status_bar booted clear` afterwards. Mouse-wheel scrolling
doesn't work in the simulator; drag slowly (mouse down, small moves, pause,
release) to avoid flinging. Outside demo mode, **never finish a match or
add notes** on the owner's account without asking, and blur real people's
names (`blur` boxes). Writing files into the repo while recording makes the
dev client flash a blue "Refreshing…" banner — cut around it.

- **Screenshots:** raw iPhone PNGs go in `screenshots-raw/` (gitignored),
  named per the `SHOTS` list in `scripts/process-screenshots.mjs`;
  `pnpm --filter @riftlog/web screenshots` crops the status bar, blurs
  `blur` boxes, and writes 1x/2x WebP plus the size manifest. Render them
  only through `PhoneFrame`. Landscape shots (`board-landscape`,
  `between-games-landscape`) are captured with Simulator cmd+← (`rotate:
  270`; a cmd+→ capture needs 90); `PhoneFrame` draws the island band on the
  right for any shot wider than tall. The hero shows the landscape board via
  `HeroPhone`'s rotate button.
- **Recordings** (`public/videos/<name>.mp4` + `.webm`, listed in
  `src/components/videos.ts`): record with
  `xcrun simctl io booted recordVideo --codec=h264 --force screenshots-raw/<name>.mp4`
  (stop it with `pkill -INT -f "simctl io booted recordVideo"`), find the cut
  points on a contact sheet (`ffmpeg -i x.mp4 -vf "fps=2,scale=160:-1,tile=10x4"
  -frames:v 1 sheet.png`), then cut, crop the status bar (162 px at 3x), scale
  to 2x (780 wide portrait, 1592 landscape after `transpose=2`), and encode
  H.264 (`-crf 26 -movflags +faststart`, no audio) and VP9 (`-crf 38`).

  poster still stands in). The face-off (`intro`) has its own wide strip,
  `FaceOff`, under the hero. Feature rows size their phones by count
  (`PHONE_W` in `FeatureSection`) so a row fits the desktop width.

  poster still stands in). The face-off (`intro`) has its own wide strip,
  `FaceOff`, under the hero. Feature rows size their phones by count
  (`PHONE_W` in `FeatureSection`) so a row fits the desktop width.
P**Taking the shots** in the app's **demo mode** (`apps/mobile/lib/demo.ts`:
start Metro with `EXPO_PUBLIC_DEMO=1` — a varied, made-up history with
fictional opponents around the owner's real Rivon deck; nothing is saved,
so a demo match may be played to the end). Card art is allowed in shots
and clips. Set a clean status bar with
`xcrun simctl status_bar booted override --time 9:41 --batteryState charged --batteryLevel 100 --cellularBars 4 --wifiBars 3`,
capture with `xcrun simctl io booted screenshot screenshots-raw/<name>.png`,
and `xcrun simctl status_bar booted clear` afterwards. Mouse-wheel scrolling
doesn't work in the simulator; drag slowly (mouse down, small moves, pause,
release) to avoid flinging. Outside demo mode, **never finish a match or
add notes** on the owner's account without asking, and blur real people's
names (`blur` boxes). Writing files into the repo while recording makes the
dev client flash a blue "Refreshing…" banner — cut around it.

- **Screenshots:** raw iPhone PNGs go in `screenshots-raw/` (gitignored),
  named per the `SHOTS` list in `scripts/process-screenshots.mjs`;
  `pnpm --filter @riftlog/web screenshots` crops the status bar, blurs
  `blur` boxes, and writes 1x/2x WebP plus the size manifest. Render them
  only through `PhoneFrame`. Landscape shots (`board-landscape`,
  `between-games-landscape`) are captured with Simulator cmd+← (`rotate:
  270`; a cmd+→ capture needs 90); `PhoneFrame` draws the island band on the
  right for any shot wider than tall. The hero shows the landscape board via
  `HeroPhone`'s rotate button.
- **Recordings** (`public/videos/<name>.mp4` + `.webm`, listed in
  `src/components/videos.ts`): record with
  `xcrun simctl io booted recordVideo --codec=h264 --force screenshots-raw/<name>.mp4`
  (stop it with `pkill -INT -f "simctl io booted recordVideo"`), find the cut
  points on a contact sheet (`ffmpeg -i x.mp4 -vf "fps=2,scale=160:-1,tile=10x4"
  -frames:v 1 sheet.png`), then cut, crop the status bar (162 px at 3x), scale
  to 2x (780 wide portrait, 1592 landscape after `transpose=2`), and encode
  H.264 (`-crf 26 -movflags +faststart`, no audio) and VP9 (`-crf 38`).
  Clips are silent, a few seconds, ~100–250 KB. `PhoneFrame video=…` →
  `LoopVideo`: plays only while on screen, never with reduced motion (the
  poster still stands in). The face-off (`intro`) has its own wide strip,
  `FaceOff`, under the hero. Feature rows size their phones by count
  (`PHONE_W` in `FeatureSection`) so a row fits the desktop width.

start Metro with `EXPO_PUBLIC_DEMO=1` — a varied, made-up history with
fictional opponents around the owner's real Rivon deck; nothing is saved,
so a demo match may be played to the end). Card art is allowed in shots
and clips. Set a clean status bar with
`xcrun simctl status_bar booted override --time 9:41 --batteryState charged --batteryLevel 100 --cellularBars 4 --wifiBars 3`,
capture with `xcrun simctl io booted screenshot screenshots-raw/<name>.png`,
and `xcrun simctl status_bar booted clear` afterwards. Mouse-wheel scrolling
doesn't work in the simulator; drag slowly (mouse down, small moves, pause,
release) to avoid flinging. Outside demo mode, **never finish a match or
add notes** on the owner's account without asking, and blur real people's
names (`blur` boxes). Writing files into the repo while recording makes the
dev client flash a blue "Refreshing…" banner — cut around it.

- **Screenshots:** raw iPhone PNGs go in `screenshots-raw/` (gitignored),
  named per the `SHOTS` list in `scripts/process-screenshots.mjs`;
  `pnpm --filter @riftlog/web screenshots` crops the status bar, blurs
  `blur` boxes, and writes 1x/2x WebP plus the size manifest. Render them
  only through `PhoneFrame`. Landscape shots (`board-landscape`,
  `between-games-landscape`) are captured with Simulator cmd+← (`rotate:
  270`; a cmd+→ capture needs 90); `PhoneFrame` draws the island band on the
  right for any shot wider than tall. The hero shows the landscape board via
  `HeroPhone`'s rotate button.
- **Recordings** (`public/videos/<name>.mp4` + `.webm`, listed in
  `src/components/videos.ts`): record with
  `xcrun simctl io booted recordVideo --codec=h264 --force screenshots-raw/<name>.mp4`
  (stop it with `pkill -INT -f "simctl io booted recordVideo"`), find the cut
  points on a contact sheet (`ffmpeg -i x.mp4 -vf "fps=2,scale=160:-1,tile=10x4"
  -frames:v 1 sheet.png`), then cut, crop the status bar (162 px at 3x), scale
  to 2x (780 wide portrait, 1592 landscape after `transpose=2`), and encode
  H.264 (`-crf 26 -movflags +faststart`, no audio) and VP9 (`-crf 38`).
  Clips are silent, a few seconds, ~100–250 KB. `PhoneFrame video=…` →
  `LoopVideo`: plays only while on screen, never with reduced motion (the
  poster still stands in). The face-off (`intro`) has its own wide strip,
  `FaceOff`, under the hero. Feature rows size their phones by count
  (`PHONE_W` in `FeatureSection`) so a row fits the desktop width.

`xcrun simctl status_bar booted override --time 9:41 --batteryState charged --batteryLevel 100 --cellularBars 4 --wifiBars 3`,
capture with `xcrun simctl io booted screenshot screenshots-raw/<name>.png`,
and `xcrun simctl status_bar booted clear` afterwards. Mouse-wheel scrolling
doesn't work in the simulator; drag slowly (mouse down, small moves, pause,
release) to avoid flinging. Outside demo mode, **never finish a match or
add notes** on the owner's account without asking, and blur real people's
names (`blur` boxes). Writing files into the repo while recording makes the
dev client flash a blue "Refreshing…" banner — cut around it.

- **Screenshots:** raw iPhone PNGs go in `screenshots-raw/` (gitignored),
  named per the `SHOTS` list in `scripts/process-screenshots.mjs`;
  `pnpm --filter @riftlog/web screenshots` crops the status bar, blurs
  `blur` boxes, and writes 1x/2x WebP plus the size manifest. Render them
  only through `PhoneFrame`. Landscape shots (`board-landscape`,
  `between-games-landscape`) are captured with Simulator cmd+← (`rotate:
  270`; a cmd+→ capture needs 90); `PhoneFrame` draws the island band on the
  right for any shot wider than tall. The hero shows the landscape board via
  `HeroPhone`'s rotate button.
- **Recordings** (`public/videos/<name>.mp4` + `.webm`, listed in
  `src/components/videos.ts`): record with
  `xcrun simctl io booted recordVideo --codec=h264 --force screenshots-raw/<name>.mp4`
  (stop it with `pkill -INT -f "simctl io booted recordVideo"`), find the cut
  points on a contact sheet (`ffmpeg -i x.mp4 -vf "fps=2,scale=160:-1,tile=10x4"
  -frames:v 1 sheet.png`), then cut, crop the status bar (162 px at 3x), scale
  to 2x (780 wide portrait, 1592 landscape after `transpose=2`), and encode
  H.264 (`-crf 26 -movflags +faststart`, no audio) and VP9 (`-crf 38`).
  Clips are silent, a few seconds, ~100–250 KB. `PhoneFrame video=…` →
  `LoopVideo`: plays only while on screen, never with reduced motion (the
  poster still stands in). The face-off (`intro`) has its own wide strip,
  `FaceOff`, under the hero. Feature rows size their phones by count
  (`PHONE_W` in `FeatureSection`) so a row fits the desktop width.
